widget.name: Styled QR Code
widget.description: Branded QR codes: dot and corner styles, gradients, logo, circle shape and a 'Scan me' frame. Builds UPI, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, phone and geo payloads, saves the image as base64 to an attribute, downloads as SVG/PNG/JPEG/WEBP, copies, prints, refreshes on a timer with an expiry countdown, checks that the code still scans and renders a whole list in bulk mode.

property.caption: Render as
property.description: 'Single' renders one QR code from the page context and offers all payload templates. 'List' renders one QR code per object of a data source.

property.caption: Payload
property.description: What the QR code encodes. Templates build the correct string from the fields below; 'Text or URL' encodes the value as is.

property.caption: Value
property.description: Text or URL to encode, e.g. 'https://mxtechies.com' or $currentObject/Code.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Optional text shown under the QR code.

property.caption: Payee VPA
property.description: UPI id of the payee (pa), e.g. 'shop@upi'.

property.caption: Payee name
property.description: Name shown in the payment app (pn).

property.caption: Amount
property.description: Amount to pay (am). Leave empty to let the payer enter it.

property.caption: Currency
property.description: ISO currency code (cu). UPI currently only supports INR.

property.caption: Note
property.description: Transaction note shown to the payer (tn).

property.caption: Transaction reference
property.description: Your own reference for reconciliation (tr), e.g. an order number.

property.caption: Network name (SSID)
property.description: Name of the Wi-Fi network.

property.caption: Password
property.description: Wi-Fi password. Ignored for open networks.

property.caption: Encryption
property.description: Security type of the network.

property.caption: Hidden network
property.description: True when the network does not broadcast its SSID.

property.caption: First name
property.description: Given name of the contact.

property.caption: Last name
property.description: Family name of the contact.

property.caption: Organization
property.description: Company or organization.

property.caption: Job title
property.description: Role or job title.

property.caption: Phone
property.description: Work phone number.

property.caption: Mobile
property.description: Mobile phone number.

property.caption: Email
property.description: Email address.

property.caption: Website
property.description: URL of the contact's website.

property.caption: Address
property.description: Postal address on one line, e.g. 'Street 1, City, 12345, Country'.

property.caption: Note
property.description: Free text note stored with the contact.

property.caption: vCard version
property.description: 3.0 is read by every phone; 4.0 supports more fields.

property.caption: Home phone
property.description: Home phone number.

property.caption: Birthday
property.description: Date of birth.

property.caption: Street
property.description: Street and number. When set, the address parts replace the single-line address.

property.caption: City
property.description: City.

property.caption: Region
property.description: State or province.

property.caption: Postal code
property.description: Postal code.

property.caption: Country
property.description: Country.

property.caption: Photo
property.description: Static or dynamic image embedded as the contact photo (keep it small, it makes the code much denser).

property.caption: Photo URL
property.description: Alternative to 'Photo': a URL of the contact photo. Used when no photo image is set.

property.caption: To
property.description: Recipient email address.

property.caption: Subject
property.description: Prefilled subject line.

property.caption: Body
property.description: Prefilled message body.

property.caption: Phone number
property.description: Number the SMS is sent to, including the country code.

property.caption: Message
property.description: Prefilled SMS text.

property.caption: Phone number
property.description: Number to dial, including the country code, e.g. '+919876543210'.

property.caption: Latitude
property.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827.

property.caption: Longitude
property.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707.

property.caption: Map app
property.description: Which map service the link opens. Uses the latitude and longitude of the Geo location group.

property.caption: Place label
property.description: Optional name shown for the pin, e.g. 'MX Techies office'.

property.caption: Title
property.description: Name of the event.

property.caption: Start
property.description: Start date and time.

property.caption: End
property.description: End date and time. Defaults to one hour after the start.

property.caption: All day
property.description: True for an all-day event (only the dates are used).

property.caption: Location
property.description: Where the event takes place.

property.caption: Description
property.description: Notes added to the event.

property.caption: Phone number
property.description: WhatsApp number with country code, e.g. '+919876543210'.

property.caption: Message
property.description: Prefilled message.

property.caption: Username
property.description: Telegram username without the @, or a channel name.

property.caption: Message
property.description: Optional text shared into the chat.

property.caption: Beneficiary name
property.description: Name of the account holder (max 70 characters).

property.caption: IBAN
property.description: IBAN of the beneficiary, spaces are removed.

property.caption: BIC
property.description: BIC of the bank. Optional inside the EEA.

property.caption: Amount (EUR)
property.description: Amount in euro, 0.01 to 999999999.99. Leave empty to let the payer enter it.

property.caption: Structured reference
property.description: Creditor reference (ISO 11649), e.g. 'RF18539007547034'. Use either this or the remittance text.

property.caption: Remittance text
property.description: Free text shown to the payer (max 140 characters).

property.caption: Purpose code
property.description: Optional 4-letter ISO 20022 purpose code, e.g. 'SALA'.

property.caption: Address
property.description: Bitcoin address.

property.caption: Amount (BTC)
property.description: Amount in BTC.

property.caption: Label
property.description: Name of the recipient.

property.caption: Message
property.description: Description of the payment.

property.caption: PayPal.Me name
property.description: The name after paypal.me/, e.g. 'mxtechies'.

property.caption: Amount
property.description: Optional amount.

property.caption: Currency
property.description: ISO currency code, e.g. 'USD' or 'EUR'.

property.caption: Proxy type
property.description: What identifies the receiver.

property.caption: Proxy value
property.description: Mobile number (with or without country code), national ID or e-Wallet ID.

property.caption: Amount (THB)
property.description: Optional fixed amount in baht.

property.caption: Proxy type
property.description: What identifies the receiver.

property.caption: Proxy value
property.description: Mobile number with country code (+65...) or the UEN.

property.caption: Merchant name
property.description: Name shown in the banking app (max 25 characters).

property.caption: Amount (SGD)
property.description: Optional amount in Singapore dollars.

property.caption: Amount editable
property.description: Whether the payer may change the amount.

property.caption: Reference
property.description: Optional bill or reference number.

property.caption: Expiry
property.description: Optional expiry date of the payment request.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: Objects to render one QR code each. Used when 'Render as' is 'List of QR codes'.

property.caption: Value per object
property.description: Text or URL to encode for each object, e.g. $currentObject/AssetCode. Build UPI or vCard strings in a calculated attribute if you need them per object.

property.caption: Label per object
property.description: Optional text shown under each QR code.

property.caption: Gap (px)
property.description: Space between the QR codes in the list.

property.caption: File name per object
property.description: File name (without extension) used for downloads and the ZIP, e.g. $currentObject/AssetCode. Defaults to the file name below.

property.caption: Logo URL per object
property.description: Optional logo URL per object, e.g. an image URL attribute. Falls back to the logo of the Design tab.

property.caption: Render when visible
property.description: Renders each code only when it scrolls into view. Recommended for lists of more than a few dozen codes.

property.caption: Empty message
property.description: Text shown when the data source returns no objects.

property.caption: Size (px)
property.description: Width and height of the QR code in pixels. It scales down to fit its container.

property.caption: Sizing
property.description: 'Fixed' uses the size in pixels. 'Fit container' stretches the code to the width of its container (the pixel size is still used for exports).

property.caption: Margin (px)
property.description: Quiet zone around the code, in pixels.

property.caption: Shape
property.description: Overall shape of the code. 'Circle' places the modules inside a circle.

property.caption: Draw with
property.description: 'SVG' stays sharp at any zoom and prints best; 'Canvas' is a bitmap.

property.caption: Dot style
property.description: Shape of the data modules.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Any CSS color, e.g. '#1a73e8' or 'rgb(0,0,0)'.

property.caption: Gradient
property.description: Fill the dots with a gradient from 'Color' to 'Gradient end color'.

property.caption: Gradient end color
property.description: Second color of the gradient.

property.caption: Gradient rotation (deg)
property.description: Angle of a linear gradient in degrees.

property.caption: Gradient colour stops
property.description: Optional extra colour stops for the gradient. When given, they replace the two-colour gradient (offset 0 to 100 percent).

property.caption: Offset (%)
property.description: Position of the colour along the gradient, 0 = start, 100 = end.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Any CSS colour.

property.caption: Round dot size
property.description: Rounds the module size to whole pixels so edges stay crisp. Turn off for exact sizing.

property.caption: Corner square style
property.description: Shape of the three large finder squares. 'Same as dots' follows the dot style.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Leave empty to use the dot color.

property.caption: Gradient
property.description: Fill the corner squares with a gradient.

property.caption: Gradient end color
property.description: Second color of the gradient.

property.caption: Gradient rotation (deg)
property.description: Angle of a linear gradient in degrees.

property.caption: Gradient colour stops
property.description: Optional extra colour stops for the gradient. When given, they replace the two-colour gradient (offset 0 to 100 percent).

property.caption: Offset (%)
property.description: Position of the colour along the gradient, 0 = start, 100 = end.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Any CSS colour.

property.caption: Corner dot style
property.description: Shape of the small square inside each finder. 'Same as dots' follows the dot style.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Leave empty to use the dot color.

property.caption: Gradient
property.description: Fill the corner dots with a gradient.

property.caption: Gradient end color
property.description: Second color of the gradient.

property.caption: Gradient rotation (deg)
property.description: Angle of a linear gradient in degrees.

property.caption: Gradient colour stops
property.description: Optional extra colour stops for the gradient. When given, they replace the two-colour gradient (offset 0 to 100 percent).

property.caption: Offset (%)
property.description: Position of the colour along the gradient, 0 = start, 100 = end.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Any CSS colour.

property.caption: Transparent
property.description: Draws no background so the page shows through. Exports keep the transparency (PNG, WEBP, SVG).

property.caption: Color
property.description: Background color behind the code.

property.caption: Corner rounding (%)
property.description: Rounds the background corners, 0 = square, 100 = fully round.

property.caption: Gradient
property.description: Fill the background with a gradient.

property.caption: Gradient end color
property.description: Second color of the gradient.

property.caption: Gradient rotation (deg)
property.description: Angle of a linear gradient in degrees.

property.caption: Gradient colour stops
property.description: Optional extra colour stops for the gradient. When given, they replace the two-colour gradient (offset 0 to 100 percent).

property.caption: Offset (%)
property.description: Position of the colour along the gradient, 0 = start, 100 = end.

property.caption: Colour
property.description: Any CSS colour.

property.caption: Logo image
property.description: Static image or dynamic image (System.Image) drawn in the middle of the code.

property.caption: Logo URL
property.description: Alternative to 'Logo image': a URL or data URI of the logo. Used when no logo image is set.

property.caption: Logo size (%)
property.description: Size of the logo relative to the code. Keep it under about 40% and use error correction 'H' so the code still scans.

property.caption: Logo margin (px)
property.description: Space kept clear around the logo.

property.caption: Hide dots behind logo
property.description: Removes the modules under the logo instead of drawing the logo on top of them.

property.caption: Cross-origin
property.description: How the logo is fetched. 'Anonymous' is required for downloads and copy when the logo is on another domain.

property.caption: Show frame
property.description: Draws a colored frame with a label such as 'Scan me' around the code. The frame is included in downloads, copy and print.

property.caption: Frame label
property.description: Text on the frame, e.g. 'Scan me'.

property.caption: Label position
property.description: Where the label bar sits.

property.caption: Frame style
property.description: 'Solid' fills the frame with the frame colour. 'Outline' draws only a border and a coloured label. 'Pill' keeps the code borderless and shows the label as a rounded pill.

property.caption: Label icon
property.description: Icon shown before the label text. Image icons are included in exports; glyph icons only on screen.

property.caption: Label font
property.description: CSS font family for the label, e.g. 'Inter, sans-serif'. Empty uses Helvetica/Arial.

property.caption: Frame color
property.description: Color of the frame border and label bar.

property.caption: Label text color
property.description: Color of the label text.

property.caption: Frame corner radius (px)
property.description: Rounding of the frame corners.

property.caption: Error correction
property.description: How much of the code may be damaged or covered and still scan: L 7%, M 15%, Q 25%, H 30%. Use H with a logo.

property.caption: Version (type number)
property.description: QR version 1 to 40, which fixes the module count (21x21 up to 177x177). 0 picks the smallest version that fits the data.

property.caption: Encoding mode
property.description: Character set used to encode the data. 'Automatic' picks the most compact mode that fits.

property.caption: Max payload length
property.description: Codes longer than this many characters are not rendered; the message below is shown instead. The QR limit is 2953 bytes at level L, less at higher levels.

property.caption: Too long message
property.description: Shown when the payload exceeds the maximum length.

translations.translation: The content is too long for a QR code.

property.caption: Check scannability
property.description: Decodes the rendered code again after each render and warns when it cannot be read, for example because the logo is too big or the contrast is too low.

property.caption: Warning text
property.description: Shown under the code when the check fails.

translations.translation: This QR code may not scan. Reduce the logo size, raise the error correction or increase the contrast.

property.caption: Scannable attribute
property.description: Optional Boolean attribute that receives the result of the check.

property.caption: Download PNG
property.description: Shows a button that downloads the code as PNG.

property.caption: Download SVG
property.description: Shows a button that downloads the code as SVG.

property.caption: Download JPEG
property.description: Shows a button that downloads the code as JPEG.

property.caption: Download WEBP
property.description: Shows a button that downloads the code as WEBP.

property.caption: Copy to clipboard
property.description: Shows a button that copies the code as a PNG image to the clipboard.

property.caption: Print
property.description: Shows a button that opens the print dialog with only the QR code.

property.caption: Save now
property.description: Shows a button that writes the base64 attribute and runs 'On image saved' on demand (single mode with a base64 attribute).

property.caption: Download all (ZIP)
property.description: List mode: shows a button that downloads every code as PNG in one ZIP file.

property.caption: Print label sheet
property.description: List mode: shows a button that prints all codes as a label sheet.

property.caption: Download label sheet (PDF)
property.description: List mode: shows a button that downloads all codes as a PDF label sheet.

property.caption: File name
property.description: Name of the downloaded file without extension.

property.caption: Button style
property.description: Atlas button style used for the toolbar.

property.caption: Position
property.description: Whether the buttons are shown above or below the code.

property.caption: Download label
property.description: Prefix of the download buttons, followed by the format.

property.caption: Copy label
property.description: Text of the copy button.

property.caption: Copied label
property.description: Text of the copy button right after a successful copy.

property.caption: Print label
property.description: Text of the print button.

property.caption: Save label
property.description: Text of the 'Save now' button.

property.caption: Saved label
property.description: Text of the 'Save now' button right after saving.

property.caption: ZIP label
property.description: Text of the 'Download all' button.

property.caption: Print sheet label
property.description: Text of the 'Print label sheet' button.

property.caption: PDF label
property.description: Text of the 'Download PDF' button.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Number of labels per row on the printed or PDF sheet.

property.caption: Label width (mm)
property.description: Width of one label on the sheet.

property.caption: Label height (mm)
property.description: Height of one label on the sheet.

property.caption: Gap (mm)
property.description: Space between labels.

property.caption: Show label text
property.description: Prints the per-object label under each code.

property.caption: Sheet title
property.description: Optional title printed at the top of the sheet and used as the PDF file name.

property.caption: Base64 attribute
property.description: String attribute (unlimited length) that receives the rendered image as base64 after every render. Decode it with Community Commons 'Base64DecodeToFile' into a System.Image to use it in documents and emails.

property.caption: Image format
property.description: Format of the saved image.

property.caption: Include data URI prefix
property.description: Prefixes the value with 'data:image/png;base64,' so it can be used directly as an image source. Leave off for Base64DecodeToFile.

property.caption: Save delay (ms)
property.description: Waits this long after the last change before writing the attribute, so typing in a field does not write on every keystroke.

property.caption: On image saved
property.description: Runs after the base64 attribute has been written, e.g. a microflow that stores it as a System.Image.

property.caption: Refresh interval (s)
property.description: Runs 'On refresh' every N seconds, e.g. a nanoflow that fetches a new token. 0 disables the timer.

property.caption: On refresh
property.description: Action run on every tick of the refresh interval. Change the attribute the value is based on and the code re-renders.

property.caption: Expires at
property.description: Date and time the code stops being valid. Shows a countdown and dims the code once expired.

property.caption: Countdown label
property.description: Text under the code while it is valid. [time] is replaced by the remaining time, e.g. 04:59.

property.caption: Expired label
property.description: Text shown over the code once it has expired.

property.caption: Blur when expired
property.description: Blurs the code so it cannot be scanned after it expired.

property.caption: On expire
property.description: Runs once when the expiry time passes, e.g. to fetch a new code.

property.caption: On click
property.description: Runs when the QR code is clicked.

property.caption: On render
property.description: Runs after every render with the encoded value and the scannability result, e.g. to log which codes were generated.

property.caption: Aria label
property.description: Screen reader description of the code.
